headline: Bing tests a separate "AI-Generated answer" card
dek: Bing is testing a new answer card labeled "AI-Generated answer" that looks different from its AI Overviews and Copilot Search boxes. Search Engine Watch spotted it first on mobile, and Barry Schwartz of Search Engine Roundtable reproduced it on mobile and desktop on November 24. Microsoft has not commented, and Schwartz said he was not sure how it differs from Bing's other AI formats.
why: Bing now has several AI answer formats running at once, and each is another spot where a business can be cited or left out. It is a test, so it may change or disappear.
doThis: Add a few Bing searches to your monthly AI visibility check, and make sure your Bing Places listing and Bing Webmaster Tools account are set up and current.
